name: Galgamácsa (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Galgamácsa (a crowned blue shield with a white bird and a cross) above the name GALGAMÁCSA in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
